entry.name: jit.freeframe
entry.description: Provides support for using FreeFrame effects within Jitter. It supports both single and dual input effects, and 32-bit and 16-bit data sizes.

attributes.name: inmode
attributes.digest: Input mode
attributes.description: The matrix input mode (jitter/freeframe).Theandattributes provide an optimization when building chains ofobjects. Because Jitter and FreeFrame use different byte-padding, matrices generally have to be copied to a new buffer when the arrive at aobject, and copied back into a Jitter matrix after processing, before output. If severalobjects will be used to sequentially process data, this copying step can be avoided.The first object in the chain should haveset to, andset to. All subsequent objects should have both attributes set to, except for the last one, which should haveset to, andset to.

messages.name: anything
messages.description: If the message selector matches the name of a parameter, functions like themessage, taking a single(or, in the case ofparameters) argument.If the message selector matches the word, followed by the name of a parameter (e.g., the message has the same effect as themessage, but requiring no further arguments.

messages.name: geteffectlist
messages.description: Sends a list out the object's right outlet comprising the names of all available FreeFrame effects, preceded by the word. On Macintosh, FreeFrame effects must be located either in thefolder, or in a directory called, within the Max search path. On Windows, FreeFrame effects must be located either in thefolder, or in a directory called, within the Max search path.

messages.name: getparam
messages.description: Sends a list out the object's right outlet containing the current value of the parameter specified by theargument (either by name or by index into the list returned by). The list is formatted as. Theargument is the name of the parameters, thethe value, andis an alternate display value, for parameters whose "real value", as understood by the parameter, lies outside of the range 0-1.

messages.name: getparamlist
messages.description: Sends lists out the object's right outlet describing the parameters for the currently selected effect, one list per parameter (see). The list or lists are in the form.

messages.name: loadeffect
messages.description: Selects an available FreeFrame effect for use. The effect must be specified by its name, as reported by themessage.

messages.name: param
messages.description: Sets the value of the parameter specified by theargument (either by name or by index into the list returned by). All parameters, regardless of type (with the exception of), accept a single floating-point number between 0 and 1 as input. See themessage for additional information on parameter types.

messages.name: reload
messages.description: Causes the object to rescan the FreeFrame plugins folders and add any new plugins to its list of effects. See themethod for more details.
